newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EXPLOSION KILLS ONE IN VILNIUS.
newsitem.headline: EXPLOSION KILLS ONE IN VILNIUS.

text.p: An explosion killed one man and damaged vehicles near a market in the Lithuanian capital on Friday, police said.
They could not say what caused the explosion but one official said there was a smell of gunpowder and that the blast was around the size of a grenade.

"At the moment it seems that the person was looking in the (waste) container when the explosion came but the investigatin is going on and it is hard to give more details," head of the district civil protection, Povilas Kalkauskas, told Reuters.
